text: On Jack's machine, Claude Code's ACP adapter is the standalone release build of `agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp` v0.101.0, unpacked to `~/.local/share/claude-agent-acp/`. The folder holds `claude-agent-acp` and the bundled `claude` it runs from beside itself, and needs no node. `~/.config/coax/config.toml` points its `claude` entry at that full path. Nothing updates it. A new version means downloading the release tarball again.
